api_keys_payment_limits_check.name: api_keys_payment_limits_check
api_keys_payment_limits_check.value:
case when "api_keys"."kind" = 'payment' then "api_keys"."daily_budget" is not null
    else "api_keys"."allowance" is null and "api_keys"."daily_budget" is null and "api_keys"."max_price" is null and "api_keys"."expires_at" is null end

upstream_hosts_missing_check.name: upstream_hosts_missing_check
upstream_hosts_missing_check.value: "upstream_hosts"."state" not in ('missing', 'suspended') or "upstream_hosts"."missing_since" is not null
